title: React v2 Living System Foundation: Ambient animations, shimmer, springs, and critical pulse
goal: Implement the core ambient animations that make the UI feel 'alive' as described in LIVING_SYSTEM_EXPERIENCE.md. (1) Task Shimmer: running tasks in Mission Control must have the sweeping background shimmer animation. (2) Severity Bar Spring: finding severity bars grow using spring physics (cubic-bezier), not linear transitions. (3) Finding Badge Pop: new findings trigger a bouncy scale animation on their count badges. (4) Empty State Breathing: subtle opacity/scale pulse on empty state icons. (5) Critical Pulse: when a critical finding arrives, the screen dims slightly (vignette) and the red counter pulses prominently.
scope: Global UI animations and specific component states in Mission Control and Findings.
generation_reason: The user requested the system feel alive and dynamic, transitioning away from a static, hard-to-read dashboard.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Only implement the visual CSS/JS animations and state transitions. Do not alter data fetching logic.

success_criteria: Finding severity bars animate smoothly on load/change.
Critical finding simulation triggers screen dim and pulse.

acceptance_criteria: All described animations are present and smooth.
